parsed.answer: This feature has been requested before. PowerToys#37939 ("Stage Manager like a MacOS") asks for the same thing: a sidebar of window groups, where clicking a group rearranges its windows on screen, ideally built on Workspaces. The ticket shows no maintainer decision or implementation, so nothing is available today. The best step is to add your mockup and your answers to the design questions (Workspaces versus a new utility, multi-monitor scope, no taskbar regrouping) as a comment on #37939 and upvote it, rather than opening a new ticket. Related ticket PowerToys#15083 ("Group mode for windows") asked for a simpler form of grouping. The maintainer closed it as a duplicate, saying it is a big work item that Windows already covers with Snap layouts and Snap groups, and that they would rather push for support in Windows itself. Until something ships, Snap layouts (Win+Z) plus virtual desktops are the closest built-in options. Your offer to prototype it is worth raising on #37939 so the maintainers can say whether they would accept a PR.
